notes: The subject begins with an active adapter-selected application interaction subscription and a passive HLAreportServiceInvocation subscription from the adapter-supplied IEEE 1516.2-2025 MIM. It unsubscribes the passive class, confirms the active application class remains, then unsubscribes the last interaction class and confirms a fresh HLArequestSubscriptions response has the MIM-defined empty interaction-class list. The scenario uses only official IEEE 1516.1-2025 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard MIM interactions, standard encoding DataElements, and the C++ standard library. Provider, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, application interaction name, and update-rate designator remain adapter supplied. No vendor API, private headers, or DDM regions are used.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual void unsubscribeInteractionClass( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass) = 0
